title: SceneFake: An Initial Dataset and Benchmarks for Scene Fake Audio Detection
reasoning: The paper explicitly discusses the ethical implications of scene-manipulated audio, stating it 'will pose a major threat to our society if some people misuse the manipulated audio with malicious purpose' (page 1), 'mislead the public if scene-manipulated audio was disseminated widely on social media for unethical purposes' (page 2), and challenges 'audio forensics' for 'integrity verification and authenticity of the evidence in a court of law' (page 3). The motivation for the dataset and research is directly tied to countering these unethical and harmful uses.
